changelog: Separated all Video Studio features into individual 48dp+ direct buttons in Project Hub and Video Studio (keeping Save, Preview & Export intact), separated Audio Effects and Video Color Filters / VFX into distinct clickable buttons and panels, and added slow Rewind & Fast-Forward scrubbing speeds (0.25x, 0.5x, 0.75x, 1.0x) alongside fast speeds.
